query: SELECT CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE $3 AS DATE) AS revenue_day,        COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), $4) AS revenue,        COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1   AND created_at < $2 GROUP BY CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) ORDER BY revenue_day ASC

SELECT customer_id,        COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), $4) AS total_spent,        COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1   AND created_at < $2 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT $3
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1   AND created_at < $2 GROUP BY status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), $3) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1   AND created_at < $2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1   AND created_at < $2
INSERT INTO order_items (     id, order_id, product_id, product_name,     quantity, unit_price, subtotal ) VALUES (     $1, $2, $3, $4,     $5, $6, $7 )

INSERT INTO order_status_history (     id, order_id, previous_status, new_status, changed_at ) VALUES (     $1, $2, $3, $4, $5 )
UPDATE orders SET status = $1,     updated_at = $2 WHERE id = $3
SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ANY($1)
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1
